facts.fact: Jessica 采买 crunkle、elk's blood 与 Tigglestide 装饰品，为 Tigglestide Eve 晚餐备料
facts.anchor: Jessica returned from the market with a string of crunkle, a crate of elk’s blood, and a box of Tigglestide decorations

facts.fact: Jessica 在玩具店买大兔子玩偶，只取耳朵做 makeshift bunny costume，想让 Greg 惊喜
facts.anchor: purchased a large rabbit plush, which she planned to strip for her makeshift bunny costume. She only needed the ears.

facts.fact: Sandy 冲进厨房报信：在 bog 见到 Round Robin，并断言 Helena Hollyoak 是女巫
facts.anchor: We saw him in the bog! Round Robin! And also Helena Hollyoak was a witch!

facts.fact: Molly 上门指控：她的孩子说被 Sandy 打了
facts.anchor: My children tell me that your Sandy attacked them today.

facts.fact: Molly 以 Tigglestide 陪家人为由宣布不再来往，Jessica 大受打击
facts.anchor: I think I shouldn’t come over anymore.

facts.fact: Greg 宣布明天 Tigglestide Eve 要通宵赶工，可能赶不上晚餐
facts.anchor: I’m going to have to pull an all-nighter tomorrow.

facts.fact: Jessica 凝视画像疑心那动物根本不是 hare：吻部扁平成近乎人脸，只能靠 slipper-like 耳朵辨认
facts.anchor: the snout flattened into an almost human face with a blankly serene stare

facts.fact: 第三场梦中兔子许诺修好一切，Jessica 顺从地把修理权交出去
facts.anchor: All will be well. Let me fix this.
